title: Roll, NS as to major flour (2357)

content.title: About
content.content: Roll is a ready‑to‑bake sheet made from high‑grade flour (code 2357). The product is designed for quick preparation of bakery items at home. The dough has a soft texture, a light aroma and works well with both sweet and savory fillings.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Code 2357 refers to flour that meets strict quality standards according to GOST 28195‑89.
A typical package contains 10 sheets, each weighing about 250 g.
Vacuum packaging allows storage at room temperature for up to 12 months.
The dough is pre‑mixed, so no additional yeast or salt is required.
Roll sheets are frequently used in culinary schools to demonstrate lamination techniques.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Flour 2357 provides slowly digestible carbs that help maintain steady energy levels.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: It contains thiamine, riboflavin and niacin, which support normal metabolism.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and contributes to a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The dough is prepared without added vegetable fats, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Mineral content
items.content: Flour 2357 supplies iron, magnesium and phosphorus, essential for bone health and blood formation.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: The product contains gluten and is not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Shelf‑life after opening
items.content: Once the package is opened, the dough can dry out quickly; use within 3‑5 days.

items.title: Baking temperature control
items.content: Over‑baking may lead to the formation of acrylamide, a potentially harmful compound.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Unfold a sheet, lightly mist with water if needed, then shape as desired. Fill with sweet (curd cheese, berries) or savory (cheese, ham) fillings, roll up and bake at 180‑200 °C for 12‑15 minutes until golden.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the product in its original packaging in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, transfer to an airtight container or zip‑lock bag.
